text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower put on a fine run in the 
Kikuka-sho. As she stands immersed in deep 
emotion, Mihono Bourbon approaches her.

After speaking of her bitter regret from 
losing, she acknowledged Rice Shower as 
her rival and challenged her to a duel.

Rice Shower accepted the challenge and 
declared, in a voice loud enough for the 
entire venue to hear, "I'll win next time 
too!"

"...In order to help her talent blossom 
even further, the Nikkei Sho was chosen as 
the candidate for her next goal."
